data.value: The network connection drops for a few seconds while the address is renewed. Downloads and online games lose their connection.

data.value: Sets the TCP/IP settings back to how Windows installs them (netsh int ip reset). For connection problems that renewing the address does not fix. Needs a restart.

data.value: Microsoft describes this as having the same effect as removing and reinstalling TCP/IP: it overwrites the TCP/IP and DHCP settings in the registry. Settings stored there, such as a fixed IP address, may be lost and have to be set again. A restart is needed.

data.value: Restarts the Windows Audio service. Helps when sound is gone after switching headphones or speakers.

data.name: Quick_AudioRestartDone
data.value: Windows Audio restarted. Apps that played sound may need a restart too.

data.name: Quick_BluetoothRestartHint
data.value: Restarts the Bluetooth Support Service. Helps when headsets or controllers no longer connect.

data.name: Quick_BluetoothRestartDone
data.value: Bluetooth service restarted. Devices connect again within a few seconds.

data.name: Quick_SearchRestartHint
data.value: Restarts the Windows Search service. Helps when search finds nothing or hangs.

data.name: Quick_GraphicsRestartHint
data.value: Restarts the display adapters (pnputil). Helps after a black screen or a driver that stopped responding.

data.name: Quick_GraphicsRestartConfirm
data.value: The screens go dark for a moment. Close games and video apps first: they can crash when the graphics device restarts.

data.value: Restores the performance counter settings from the system files (lodctr /r). Helps when Task Manager, the sensors or benchmarks show no data.

Remove the CORECLR_ variables in System > About > Advanced system settings > Environment Variables and start PCOptimizer again. Nothing was changed.
